description_en: Invoke the QueryRegistrantProfileRealNameVerificationInfo API to query the identity verification documents of an information template.
description_zh: 调用QueryRegistrantProfileRealNameVerificationInfo接口查询信息模板实名认证资料
name: QueryRegistrantProfileRealNameVerificationInfo

parameters.help_en: The user IP address. You can set it to 127.0.0.1.
parameters.name: user_client_ip

parameters.help_en:
The language of error messages returned by the API. Valid values:  
zh: Chinese.  
en: English.  

Default value: en.
parameters.help_zh:
接口返回错误信息语言。取值：
zh：中文。
en：英文。

默认为en
parameters.name: lang

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the information template to be queried.  

The system automatically generates this ID after the information template is created. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/67701.html API to query the information template ID
parameters.help_zh:
待查询的信息模板的编号。

信息模板创建成功后由系统自动生成，您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/67701.html接口查询信息模板编号
parameters.name: registrant_profile_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to retrieve the identity verification image. Valid values:  
true: Retrieve the image.  
false: Do not retrieve the image.  

Default value: false.
parameters.help_zh:
是否获取实名认证图片信息。取值：
true：获取。
false：不获取。

默认值为false
parameters.name: fetch_image

IdentityCredential.description_en: The Base64-encoded image of the identity verification documents.
IdentityCredential.description_zh: 采用Base64编码的实名认证资料图片

IdentityCredentialNo.description_en: The certificate number used for identity verification.

IdentityCredentialType.description_en:
The type of certificate used for identity verification. Valid values:  
SFZ: Identity card.  
HZ: Passport.  
YYZZ: Business license.  
ORG: Organization code certificate.  
XYDM: Unified Social Credit Code certificate.  
TXZ: Mainland Travel Permits for Hong Kong and Macao Residents.  

For more certificate types, see [Certificate Types Supported for Identity Verification]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72209.html）.
IdentityCredentialType.description_zh:
实名认证证件类型。取值：
SFZ：身份证。
HZ：护照。
YYZZ：营业执照。
ORG：组织机构代码证。
XYDM：统一社会信用代码证书。
TXZ：港澳居民来往内地通行证。

更多证件类型的取值请参见[支持实名认证的证件类型]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/72209.html）

IdentityCredentialUrl.description_en: The download URL of the identity verification image.
IdentityCredentialUrl.description_zh: 实名认证图片下载地址

ModificationDate.description_en: The update time of the identity verification documents.
ModificationDate.description_zh: 实名认证资料更新时间

RegistrantProfileId.description_en: The ID of the queried information template.
RegistrantProfileId.description_zh: 查询到的信息模板的编号

SubmissionDate.description_en: The submission time of the identity verification documents.
SubmissionDate.description_zh: 实名认证资料提交时间
